chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Salih ibn Abi Hammad, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sayaba, from the one who narrated it, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about the maximum limit of pregnancy with the child in its mother's belly, how long is it? For the people say, 'Perhaps it remains in her belly for years.' So he said: 'They are lying! The maximum limit of pregnancy is nine months, not exceeding a moment; and if it were to exceed an hour, it would kill its mother before he comes out.'
ai.seo_question: What is the maximum duration of human pregnancy according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) refutes the popular notion of prolonged gestation by establishing nine months as the absolute biological limit, noting that even a slight excess would be fatal to the mother. This narration underscores the precision of divine design in human creation, a theme consistent with Shia exegetical traditions that view physiological norms as signs of God's wisdom. The hadith serves both as a medical clarification and a theological affirmation of the body's natural limits.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from salih Bin Abu Hammad, from Yunus Bin Abdul Rahman, from Abdul Rahman Bin Sayaba, from the one who narrated it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the maximum of the pregnancy with the child in the belly of its mother, how much can it be, for the people are saying, ‘Perhaps it remains in her belly for years’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They are lying! The maximum limit of the pregnancy is nine months, not exceeding a moment; and if it were to exceed an hour, it would kill its mother before he comes out’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Salih ibn abu Hammad from Yunus ibn Ibrahim from ‘Abd al- Rahman ibn Sayabah from those who narrated to him who has said the following: “I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about how long a child can remain in the mother’s womb because people say that a child may remain in mother’s womb for many years. He (the Imam) said, ‘They speak a lie. The ultimate time is nine months and it is no more even for a while because if the child remains for more than a sa‘ah, (while), his mother will be dead before he comes out.’”
